bannerDescription: We use essential storage to keep this service working. With your permission, analytics and advertising storage help us understand visits and measure campaigns. You can change your choices at any time.
preferencesDescription: Choose which optional storage categories you allow. Essential storage is always active because it is required for the service and to remember this choice.
essentialDescription: Required for core functions, security, and saving your consent choice. This category cannot be switched off.
analyticsDescription: Allows privacy-aware measurement of how the service is used. Analytics are loaded only after you opt in.
advertisingDescription: Allows advertising measurement and personalization tags to use storage after you opt in.
savedConfirmation: Your privacy choices have been saved. You can update them at any time from Cookie settings.
